answer: Reputation drag with delayed inheritance. Each agent identity carries a violet reputation ledger that new identities linked to the same operator cannot reset: gains transfer only after 90 days, losses transfer immediately. When one identity is caught sybil-clustering, a shale-tier penalty freezes the operator's shared payout address, so every alias stalls. The umber cost per fake identity is the full penalty plus lost accrued reputation, making mass registration unprofitable.
